runtime_style.visual_system: Living-street fashion photography under a bright overcast sky dome, using long-perspective compression, full human walking chains, restrained colour and real pedestrian depth rather than a clean studio backdrop.
runtime_style.mood_line: A composed subject crosses a city already in motion: calm eye contact, quiet colour and one decisive stride held inside compressed street life.
runtime_style.environment: An original non-identifiable European street with beige limestone facades, grey asphalt, worn crossing marks, parked cars and a few anonymous pedestrians; no landmark, logo, readable sign or copied storefront.
runtime_style.lighting: One neutral bright overcast sky dome with no sun disc or hard sun vector; light wraps the face and approved items, shadows stay short and soft, and no artificial rim or second key is added.
materials: beige limestone facade planes with restrained weathering
grey asphalt and worn painted crossing marks
parked vehicle surfaces and anonymous pedestrian silhouettes held inside the closed palette
approved item materials preserved truthfully while gait supplies movement
runtime_style.contrast: Gentle neutral contrast with slightly lifted blacks, long soft highlight roll-off, restrained saturation and the six-colour closed environment palette #C7B08C #2E4468 #7A4A2E #C9CDD0 #CFC5B0 #8A8A88.
runtime_style.expression_signature: Upper lids neutral to low, brows and cheekbones at rest, mouth closed with level corners, jaw relaxed, and gaze either into or just past the lens while the body continues its walk; never smile or raise the brows.
runtime_style.garment_behaviour: Motion is driven by the subject's walk rather than wind: an approved free outer edge swings, a free hem or wide leg trails with mild motion softening, and matte surfaces remain quiet without invented gloss or transparency.
optical_signature: Every frame keeps clean neutral rendering, restrained fine grain and no flare, halation, vignette or chromatic fringe.
Long-perspective compression keeps distant facades and street context visually present without naming a focal length.
Focus falloff is gradual: the approved subject is decisive, mid-ground people and cars are slightly softer, and the far street softens further.

clean_identity_hero.pose_joint_chain: Pelvis stays in walking alignment, near shoulder advances slightly, neck counter-rotates toward camera, chin remains level and the near arm completes a relaxed backward swing.
clean_identity_hero.focus: Approved face, visible eye plane and near shoulder sharp; pedestrians and facade seams fall gradually softer.
clean_identity_hero.foreground: No lens-crossing object; the near shoulder and swinging forearm are the closest planes.

environmental_hero.camera_consequence: Vertical full-length street crossing from chest height with both walking feet inside frame and generous space in the direction of travel.
environmental_hero.pose_joint_chain: Front heel plants, rear heel rises, knees remain soft, hips and shoulders counter-rotate naturally, one arm swings forward, the other back, and head pans toward lens.
environmental_hero.focus: Approved subject sharp head to foot; nearest crossing marks readable, mid pedestrians slightly soft and the street end softer.
environmental_hero.foreground: A low strip of asphalt and worn crossing paint occupies the lower edge without covering either foot.

sculptural_three_quarter.camera_consequence: Low vertical three-quarter stride from around hip height; the near leg enlarges modestly while compressed facades remain upright and ordered.
sculptural_three_quarter.pose_joint_chain: Weight transfers onto the near leg, far knee bends behind, pelvis turns three-quarter, torso counter-rotates, one elbow opens away from the waist and chin turns past camera.
sculptural_three_quarter.focus: Approved face, torso and planted near leg sharp; the trailing hem and far foot soften slightly with motion.
sculptural_three_quarter.foreground: The planted near leg and a diagonal crossing stripe form the closest lower-frame planes; no unrelated prop enters.

interference_frame.camera_consequence: Vertical medium walking portrait through one heavily defocused street-context edge while the subject remains large enough for the head and full joint chain to read.
interference_frame.pose_joint_chain: Torso stays in profile stride, near elbow bends through its forward swing, shoulders counter the hips, and head turns to hold a calm near-lens gaze.
interference_frame.focus: Approved face and central torso sharp; the passing context edge and far parked cars dissolve into soft shapes.
interference_frame.foreground: One anonymous pedestrian shoulder or parked-car mirror crosses no more than a quarter of one side, fully defocused and never covering the face.

material_or_accessory_detail.camera_consequence: Vertical waist-to-shoulder human-context detail from near chest height, keeping the walking street soft behind the approved item.
material_or_accessory_detail.pose_joint_chain: One shoulder leads, elbow flexes naturally in the stride, wrist passes beside the hip or approved accessory and fingers remain anatomically relaxed with torso attached.
material_or_accessory_detail.focus: Approved material surface, hand and wrist sharp; face remains present but secondary and street context falls soft.
material_or_accessory_detail.foreground: The approved sleeve, free hem or accessory and attached hand fill the near lower plane; never detach the detail from the person.
